skills.label: Agent SDK overview
skills.desc: Build production AI agents with Claude Code as a library

skills.label: Configure your agent
skills.desc: Configure Agent SDK sessions: compose the options object, set the model, environment, and limits, and find each feature option's page.

skills.label: Examples
skills.desc: Find a complete, runnable Agent SDK project or a guided recipe in the Claude Cookbook that matches what you want to build.

skills.label: Migrate to Claude Agent SDK
skills.desc: Guide for migrating the Claude Code TypeScript and Python SDKs to the Claude Agent SDK

skills.label: Quickstart
skills.desc: Get started with the Python or TypeScript Agent SDK to build AI agents that work autonomously

skills.label: Troubleshoot the Agent SDK
skills.desc: Fix Agent SDK errors: the Claude Code CLI fails to start or exits, your prompt generator throws, a tool message is too large, or structured output is missing.

skills.label: Configure permissions
skills.desc: Control how your agent uses tools with permission modes, hooks, and declarative allow/deny rules.

skills.label: Intercept and control agent behavior with hooks
skills.desc: Intercept and customize agent behavior at key execution points with hooks

skills.label: Observability with OpenTelemetry
skills.desc: Export traces, metrics, and events from the Agent SDK to your observability backend using OpenTelemetry.

skills.label: Rewind file changes with checkpointing
skills.desc: Track file changes during agent sessions and restore files to any previous state

skills.label: Track cost and usage
skills.desc: Learn how to track token usage, estimate costs, and configure prompt caching with the Claude Agent SDK.

skills.label: Track todos
skills.desc: Track todos in Agent SDK sessions and render Claude's progress in your application from structured tool calls

skills.label: How the agent loop works
skills.desc: Understand the message lifecycle, tool execution, context window, and architecture that power your SDK agents.

skills.label: Persist sessions to external storage
skills.desc: Mirror Agent SDK session transcripts to your own object store, key-value store, or database so other hosts can resume your sessions.

skills.label: Use Claude Code features in the SDK
skills.desc: Load project instructions, skills, hooks, and other Claude Code features into your SDK agents.

skills.label: Work with sessions
skills.desc: How sessions persist agent conversation history, and when to use continue, resume, and fork to return to a prior run.

skills.label: Extend agents with skills
skills.desc: Control which skills Claude can invoke in Claude Agent SDK sessions, dispatch commands by name, and author skills your sessions discover

skills.label: Modifying system prompts
skills.desc: Choose between the claudecode preset and a custom system prompt, and customize behavior with CLAUDE.md, output styles, append, or a fully custom prompt.

skills.label: Plugins in the SDK
skills.desc: Load custom plugins to extend Claude Code with skills, agents, hooks, and MCP servers through the Agent SDK

skills.label: Hosting the Agent SDK
skills.desc: Deploy the Agent SDK in production: subprocess architecture, session persistence, scaling, observability, and multi-tenant isolation for Docker, Kubernetes, and sandbox providers.

skills.label: Securely deploying AI agents
skills.desc: A guide to securing Claude Code and Agent SDK deployments with isolation, credential management, and network controls

skills.label: Connect to external tools with MCP
skills.desc: Configure MCP servers to extend your agent with external tools. Covers transport types, tool search for large tool sets, authentication, and error handling.

skills.label: Give Claude custom tools
skills.desc: Define custom tools with the Claude Agent SDK's in-process MCP server so Claude can call your functions, hit your APIs, and perform domain-specific operations.

skills.label: Scale to many tools with tool search
skills.desc: Scale your agent to thousands of tools by discovering and loading only what's needed, on demand.

skills.label: Subagents in the SDK
skills.desc: Define and invoke subagents to isolate context, run tasks in parallel, and apply specialized instructions in your Claude Agent SDK applications.

skills.label: Get structured output from agents
skills.desc: Return validated JSON from agent workflows using JSON Schema, Zod, or Pydantic. Get type-safe, structured data after multi-turn tool use.

skills.label: Handle approvals and user input
skills.desc: Surface Claude's approval requests and clarifying questions to users, then return their decisions to the SDK.

skills.label: Stream responses in real-time
skills.desc: Get real-time responses from the Agent SDK as text and tool calls stream in

skills.label: Streaming Input
skills.desc: Send follow-up messages and images to one Agent SDK session with streaming input, read each response, and interrupt a response to redirect Claude.

skills.desc: Complete API reference for the Python Agent SDK, including all functions, types, and classes.

skills.desc: Complete API reference for the TypeScript Agent SDK, including all functions, types, and interfaces.
